context: Checks the response keeps SOLID to class-level work, routes the other questions elsewhere and uses the documented searches.

checklist.name: Declines the service boundary question
checklist.description: The response says service and module boundary decisions are outside this skill and points to clean-architecture.

checklist.name: Declines the pattern choice
checklist.description: The response says choosing between structural patterns is outside this skill and points to design-patterns.

checklist.name: Does not decide the boundary or pattern anyway
checklist.description: The response does not make the boundary or Strategy-versus-Decorator decision itself.

checklist.name: Still answers the SOLID part
checklist.description: The response proceeds with the class-level scan request.

checklist.name: SRP search run
checklist.description: The response searches for classes mixing concerns, for example `class.*Service.*Repository|class.*Manager.*Handler`.

checklist.name: OCP search run
checklist.description: The response searches for type checks such as `instanceof|typeof.*==|switch.*type`.

checklist.name: DIP search run
checklist.description: The response searches for concrete instantiation such as `new [A-Z].*Repository\(|new [A-Z].*Service\(`.

checklist.name: Treats search hits as candidates
checklist.description: The response states matches are candidates to inspect, not confirmed violations.

checklist.name: Reports findings in the violation and refactor format
checklist.description: Any finding uses the Violation / Refactor (/ Validation) format.
